title: Fall of the Conclave of Mages

entities.name: Fall of the Conclave of Mages
entities.description: Destruction of the Conclave of Mages near the end of the Dark Age on Terisiare.

entities.name: Conclave of Mages
entities.description: School of mages assaulted by the Church of Tal and then destroyed by Ith.

entities.name: Primata Delphine
entities.description: Church of Tal leader killed by Mairsil in the assault.

entities.name: Church of Tal
entities.description: Church whose army assaulted the Conclave.

entities.name: Mairsil
entities.description: Conclave leader who drained Delphine's wards and killed her.

entities.name: Wand of Ith
entities.description: Wand Mairsil used to drain Delphine's wards.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Freed Ith and used the mirror to ignite Mairsil and restore Ith.

entities.name: Lord Ith
entities.description: Freed wizard who destroyed the citadel.

entities.name: Barl's Cage
entities.description: Prison of Ith, destroyed by Jodah and Sima.

entities.name: Rag Man
entities.description: Ith's messenger specter, killed by him.

entities.name: Barl
entities.description: Turned into Ith's new Rag Man.

entities.name: City of Shadows
entities.description: Last school of magic on Terisiare, where the surviving mages fled.

events.summary: Delphine raises an army of the Church of Tal and assaults the Conclave's citadel.
events.quote: After Primata Delphine raised an army of the Church of Tal against the Conclave of Mages , they assaulted the citadel.

events.summary: Mairsil drains Delphine's wards with the Wand of Ith, stabs her to death and burns her corpse.
events.quote: he drained her wards with the Wand of Ith and then stabbed her to death, setting fire to her corpse.

events.summary: Jodah and Sima free Ith by destroying Barl's Cage; Ith kills his Rag Man.
events.quote: Jodah and Sima had liberated Lord Ith by destroying Barl's Cage .

events.summary: Jodah redirects Ith's burning ray to set Mairsil on fire and restores Ith's sanity with the mirror.
events.quote: Jodah then used the mirror to restore Ith's sanity.

events.summary: Ith frightens the surviving mages away, crumbles the citadel and turns Barl into his new Rag Man.
events.quote: turning Barl into his new Rag Man

events.summary: The surviving mages travel to the City of Shadows.
events.quote: the surviving mages of the Conclave all traveled to the City of Shadows

relations.quote: stabbed her to death, setting fire to her corpse
